# Shape editing locks

The original fixture is generated by `tools/canvas_shape_locks_fixture.py` using
our independent grouped-drawing generator (python-docx MIT, lxml BSD). No corpus
artwork is included. It exercises all supported shape lock attributes in nested
groups, empty locks, and both XML Schema boolean spellings.

The reference application exported the exact source without saving. The paired
reference removes only `a:spLocks` elements from `word/document.xml`; other ZIP
parts are identical. Both two-page PDFs render to identical pixels at 108 dpi.
This establishes that these editing restrictions do not change the fixture's
appearance; it is not a claim of full geometry equivalence with the native reference. No spec
variation was observed. Regenerate the comparison by removing those elements
from a temporary copy, opening both files in the reference application and exporting each to PDF.

Unit tests compare locked/unlocked app scenes and anchors, reject malformed flags
and selection prohibitions, enforce immutable geometry, and verify surrounding
edits, deletion/undo, export/reopen and byte preservation. The browser regression
opens the editable fixture, decodes its three scenes, and edits/exports/reopens.
Active selection locks and extension lists remain unsupported and read-only.
